title: Scarecrow
keywords: Periodically attempts accelerated growth on a nearby eligible plant

blocks.text: Periodically attempts accelerated growth on a nearby eligible plant.

rows: Place it within the configured range of crops.
Allow the growth interval to elapse.
Check plant eligibility, maturity and the protected-callback policy.

blocks.text: One interval attempts a bounded growth action; it does not instantly grow every plant in the area.
